title: Fourier coefficient of a path expansion
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $P$ be a finite list of paths on the binary cube with real outputs, and let $\gamma$ be a binary-cube vector. The vector Fourier coefficient of the sum of the path outputs times their path indicators is the sum, over the list, of each path output multiplied by the vector Fourier coefficient of its indicator.
hypotheses_covered: The path list is finite and consists of paths on the binary cube with real outputs
